intervals.label: PETRA data taking
intervals.locator: Bethke & Wagner (2022), Table 2 (1979, March); end from Table 2 (1986, Nov. 3)
intervals.note: First data (single electron beam) in March 1979; a beam loss damaged the tracking chamber on 26 March 1979 and data taking resumed in June 1979 after repair. End = 3 November 1986 "shutdown of PETRA and the JADE experiment".
intervals.quote: March first data recorded (single e− -beam, Ebeam = 11.3 GeV)

intervals.label: PETRA shut down; experiment ended
intervals.note: JADE data were later preserved and revived; analyses continued until 2012 and data and software were released in 2022 via the CERN Open Data portal.
intervals.quote: Nov. 3 shutdown of PETRA and the JADE experiment

placements.note: Campus-grade placement: DESY published no coordinates for the PETRA experimental halls that were fetched; the marker is the DESY campus point.
placements.quote: February JADE detector moved into beam

summary.plain: The JADE particle detector at DESY's PETRA ring: a compact magnet surrounding a drift-chamber tracker and a lead-glass calorimeter, which together identified electrons, photons and jets of particles.
summary.technical: JADE detector: cylindrical drift chambers (the jet chamber has 96 drift cells in three concentric rings with 16 sense wires each) inside a thin normal-conducting solenoid, a modular array of lead-glass shower counters around the coil, an iron-yoke muon filter with drift chambers covering 92% of the solid angle, and small-angle luminosity and two-photon taggers; upgraded between 1981 and 1985.

technology.quote: interspersed by 4 or 5 layers of drift chambers covering 92% of the solid angle.
technology.value: Jet chamber with 96 drift cells in three concentric rings, lead-glass calorimeter, iron-yoke muon filter with drift chambers (92% of solid angle)
